raw_segments.text: The nations, accordingly, who have attempted to tax the revenue arising from stock, instead
of any severe inquisition of this kind, have been obliged to content themselves with some
very loose, and therefore more or less arbitrary estimation.
The extreme inequality and uncertainty of a tax assessed in this manner can be compensated
only by its extreme moderation, in consequence of which every man finds himself raided so
very much below his real revenue, that he gives himself little disturbance though his
neighbor should be raided somewhat lower.
